path_step: User initiates logout, system requests confirmation, and user cancels the logout request.
test_scenario: Verify that the system presents a confirmation dialog before logging out and that the user can successfully cancel the logout operation, remaining logged in.
test_case_title: Verify cancellation of logout request via confirmation dialog
pre_condition: A user (Teacher or Student) is successfully logged into the system and is currently on their Dashboard Page. The system is configured to display a confirmation dialog before proceeding with logout.
expected_result: Upon clicking the 'Logout' button, a confirmation dialog appears. When the user clicks 'Cancel' within this dialog, the dialog closes, and the user remains on the Dashboard Page, still logged into the system.
post_condition: The user is still logged into the system and remains on the Dashboard Page, having successfully cancelled the logout action.

test_steps.step: Ensure the user is logged in and navigate to the Dashboard Page.
Click the 'Logout' button in the navigation bar.
Verify that a confirmation dialog (e.g., 'Are you sure you want to log out?') appears on the screen.
Click the 'Cancel' button within the confirmation dialog.
Verify that the confirmation dialog closes and the user remains on the Dashboard Page.
Attempt to access a protected resource to confirm the user is still logged into the system.

test_data_fields.field_value: Are you sure you want to log out?

uncovered_conditions: UC-COM-11 Normal Flow: Step 2 (System confirms the logout request) - Cancellation path
UC-COM-11 Postconditions: Failure (User remains logged in - by choice)
